schemaMatches.quantity: 6-bit hierarchical page flags (OR-propagated up the page-table mip chain)
mathTerms: flags are ORed from child page-table mips into parent entries (hierarchical)
gaps: Only bits 0-5 are page flags; VSM_EXTENDED_FLAG_* bits 6-15 live in physical-page metadata, not in this texture.
Must not overflow 6 bits; flag mask is VSM_PAGE_FLAGS_BITS_MASK.
Final capture reports NumMips=7 (page-table hierarchy); each mip stores independent 6-bit flags and is OR-propagated, so a single entry decode is not the whole hierarchy.
